content:
The Bahrain Grand Prix weekend is streaming live for free on Apple TV, no subscription required. Interestingly, the Bahrain Grand Prix is actually being held at Sepang in Malaysia.

Watching F1 on Apple TV usually requires a paid subscription, but this weekend everyone can watch for free. You can catch up on qualifying highlights and get ready to stream tonight's main race, which starts at 3:00 AM Hong Kong time (3:00 AM Eastern Time).

If you want to watch the live broadcast, all you need is a supported device with the Apple TV app installed, to be in the United States, and to stay up late.

Race coverage begins at 1:50 AM Hong Kong time (Eastern Time), with the main race scheduled to start at 3:00 AM. Of course, if you want to sleep earlier, you can watch the replay later.

You can get the Apple TV app on Apple devices, Amazon Fire Stick, Roku, PlayStation, Xbox, Android, and more, or watch via a browser at tv.apple.com.

Qualifying was held earlier today, with Red Bull's Max Verstappen taking pole position for the first time this season, Lewis Hamilton in second, and championship leader Kim Antonelli in third. This is Red Bull's most promising shot at a win so far this season.

You might be wondering why the Bahrain Grand Prix is being held in Malaysia. Normally, the Bahrain round would take place earlier in the season, but due to the ongoing conflict in Iran, the race was forced to be cancelled, and the Bahrain organisers instead sponsored a race held elsewhere in the world.

Although Sepang is no longer part of the official F1 calendar, the circuit is beloved by fans and should provide some thrilling racing action.

Just a reminder, you can watch for free on the Apple TV app, no subscription needed. The main race starts at 3:00 AM Hong Kong time (Eastern Time), with coverage beginning at 1:50 AM.
